summary: Created one forward-declared test file with10 scenarios for incoming messages and encrypted chronological history, using real T24 outbound envelopes, official Signal, encrypted SQLite and fake HTTP. RED confirmed: missing inbound module; typecheck reports only that missing module. No implementation or existing tests changed.

acceptance.criterion: Signed mailbox challenge/poll and strict responses
acceptance.evidence: HTTP fixture independently verifies create-challenge/poll/ack signatures against stable DeviceRecord; expiry and unknown response fields reject.

acceptance.criterion: Imported sender identity/device/Signal pin required before mutation
acceptance.evidence: Untrusted sender, changed device, wrong recipient/mailbox, and real native impostor identity scenarios compare persisted state before/after.
Independent encrypted-store connection reads committed session, consumed prekey, native inbox and plaintext history from HTTP ack callback.

acceptance.criterion: Failure rollback and durable pending ack
acceptance.evidence: Injected precommit failure rolls back all records; lost ack then reopen retries ack only and preserves native state/history.

acceptance.criterion: Deduplication and malformed ciphertext fail closed
acceptance.evidence: Exact redelivery under new envelope ID leaves native state/history unchanged; modified ciphertext under same message ID rejects without ack.

acceptance.criterion: Durable chronological inbound/outbound history and redaction
acceptance.evidence: Real outbound first send/reply roundtrip requires increasing history sequence, offline reopen, no private keys in history JSON, and no plaintext in diagnostics/relay/disk.

acceptance.criterion: Outbound history is atomic with native encryption and outbox
acceptance.evidence: Injected outbound failure rolls all three back before HTTP; independent reader observes all three committed before send acceptance.

test_case_specs.history_shape: Entries expose messageId, direction inbound|outbound, plaintext and monotonic sequence; stored records under cli:history:.
test_case_specs.implementation_scope_note: Outbound must add history to the same withRuntime transaction as native encrypt/outbox; current T24 outbox cannot reconstruct plaintext history later. Native changes need no mocks.

routing.graph_used: affected outbound (graph predates T24 additions; source read is authority)
